parser_resolution: The initial heuristic treated JSON followed by a Python validation block as Python, or combined multiple Python/shell segments. Separate heredoc parsing resolves all three readerB parse failures. These were audit-parser limitations, not new reader file reads.
manual_review: Command forms are cat/sed/wc/python/python3; Python imports are json/pathlib/re. Displayed/read files are the frozen summary/questions and the same reader's own draft/output for creation/revision/validation. Writes target that reader's assigned draft/final only. No key/source/audit/other-reader file access, networking commands/modules or other API tools observed.
limits: This is source-code review of recorded calls and model-visible text, not an OS sandbox theorem or task-message decryption. Empty cat and unavailable python invocation do not supply extra game knowledge.
